parsed.name: Sutter Lambda 10-3多滤光轮控制器
parsed.description: Sutter Lambda 10-3 是用于显微成像等光学实验的高性能多滤光轮控制器，可同步控制最多 3 个滤光轮及快门，实现快速滤光片切换与激发/发射通道管理。
parsed.description_en: The Sutter Lambda 10-3 is a high-performance multi-filter wheel controller for microscopy and optical imaging workflows. It supports synchronized control of up to three filter wheels and shutters for rapid filter switching and excitation/emission path management.

actions.description_en: Set the filter wheel position and switching speed; controls wheel group A/C or wheel B.
